segments.text: Why are you holding an umbrella? >> 90% of visible skin aging is from the sun. Look guys, I know I'm pale as but I genuinely love the sun. That said, UV damages collagen, elastin, and DNA, which ages your skin. Here's how to enjoy the sun without having to pay for it later. As a general rule, get your sunlight before 10:00 a.m. or after 4:00 p.m. when the UV index is around three or below. When it's above three, protect your skin. Most people think that getting a tan is a sign of health. It's actually a sign of damaged skin. Since starting blueprint, I reversed my skin

age by the equivalent of nine years, and protection is an important part. You want to be mindful of direct sun exposure during high UV times. Use an umbrella, a face cover. For sunscreen, you want to use mineral with no fragrance and non-nano zinc oxide. Friends, the sun is great. Just be informed of the tradeoffs.
